title: include/uapi/crypto2dev.h: userspace-visible ioctl API
description:
Define the public UAPI header for /dev/wolfcrypt. Write include/uapi/wolfkm_ioctl.h.

Each fd is one session. ioctls configure the session; write()/read() stream data.

Structs to define:
- wolfkm_init_op: algo[64], op (ENCRYPT=1/DECRYPT=2/HASH=3), keylen, key[128]
- wolfkm_iv_op: iv[32], ivlen
- wolfkm_aad_op: aad __user *, aadlen (AEAD only)
- wolfkm_tag_op: tag[16], taglen (AEAD auth tag)
- wolfkm_fd_state_info: algo[64], op, initialized, bytes_written, bytes_read
- wolfkm_status: fips_state, num_algorithms, version[32]

Ioctls:
- WOLFKM_IOC_INIT      _IOW('W', 1, struct wolfkm_init_op)
- WOLFKM_IOC_SET_IV    _IOW('W', 2, struct wolfkm_iv_op)
- WOLFKM_IOC_SET_AAD   _IOW('W', 3, struct wolfkm_aad_op)
- WOLFKM_IOC_GET_TAG   _IOR('W', 4, struct wolfkm_tag_op)
- WOLFKM_IOC_SET_TAG   _IOW('W', 5, struct wolfkm_tag_op)
- WOLFKM_IOC_STATUS    _IOR('W', 6, struct wolfkm_status)
- WOLFKM_IOC_GET_STATE _IOR('W', 7, struct wolfkm_fd_state_info)

Guard with #ifndef _UAPI_WOLFKM_IOCTL_H / #define / #endif.
Include <linux/ioctl.h> and <linux/types.h>.
design: Use __u32/__u8 types (not u32/u8) since this header is shared with userspace. __user pointer annotation on all userspace pointer fields in wolfkm_crypt_op. WOLFKM_IOC_MAGIC='W'. Modeled on FreeBSD /dev/crypto OCF interface for portability. See DESIGN.md §UAPI.
acceptance_criteria: Header compiles cleanly with both gcc (userspace) and the kernel build system. All four ioctl macros evaluate to distinct non-overlapping numbers. wolfkm_status.c tool (tools/) includes this header successfully.
close_reason: Superseded: include/uapi/crypto2dev_ioctl.h exists with full 20-slot ioctl API, current struct names, and write-before-ioctl key pattern. Old issue described wolfkm_ioctl.h with different struct names and key-in-ioctl design.
